_doc: One icon set for every painted button (scripts/gen-icons.py). The MASTER is drawn once from text; every other icon is a Flux Kontext edit OF the master, so they share its light, palette, scale and framing. `out` is every file that icon replaces (one design for mail everywhere, one for praying hands, etc).
style: A single painted storybook game icon: one object, burnished warm gold and soft cream with at most one gentle accent colour, soft light from the top left, a subtle warm inner glow, a clean bold silhouette that still reads at 40 pixels, centred and filling about 78% of the frame. No text, no letters, no frame, no tile, no rounded square, no badge plate, no ground shadow. Solid flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) background filling the entire image.

master.subject: a round golden compass medallion with a four-pointed star rose
